# Assets · Loaders

12 files under `assets/Loaders/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for blockShuffle.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Loading and attention indicators. The SVG loaders here are STATIC frames — the asset store strips SVG animation; the Loader component inlines the animated originals. download.gif is the download-in-progress animation; notification_red_bell_icon.gif and notification_yellow_bell_icon.gif are the animated alert bells (red = overdue, yellow = pending).
